findings.problem: run waits to deadline-3, but timeout branch can consume kill_owned stop3s plus proc.wait1s, followed by finally repeating kill_owned stop3s. Therefore cleanup can finish around deadline+4s; assertion deadline+1 is post-facto rejection, not an absolute bound including kill grace. Global final cleanup also performs serial3s stop calls for every owned unit.
findings.requested_fix: Use one shared absolute cleanup deadline/reserve; one bounded owned cgroup kill/stop/reap pass, with every subprocess wait limited to remaining reserve. Do not repeat full3s stop in except and finally. Include restore/empty-group checks inside the absolute stage bound, no allowed deadline+1 extension. Keep existing480/120/120 limits and no resource/time enlargement.

findings.problem: export_data performs snapshot/journal structure assertions, including hardcoded156tables, before constructing/exporting any generated output. A real successful CLI producing a different pending-DDL extent or invalid chain triggers assertion and suppresses capture of actual SQL/snapshot/journal, defeating diagnostic output preservation.
findings.requested_fix: Separate bounded safe file capture from metadata acceptance. Record structural findings/incomplete status without throwing before capture, then export every safe actual added/changed generated file plus generator log, and return failure after terminal evidence if acceptance checks fail. Never label malformed/full-DDL mismatch as complete or adopt it.
